diagnosis: All four rollouts revealed and cited PF1, PF2, and PF3 correctly, so there are no disclosure or telepathy problems. The gate failed because two rollouts had ENCODING MISMATCH failures: rollout 2 failed C5 (linked to PF1) because its first commitment said only "east distribution panel work sheet" without mentioning "generator load test" or the "0800-1000" window, and rollout 3 failed C7 (linked to PF3) because its third commitment said only "protected-network maintenance window (1200-1400)" without mentioning "encryption-key synchronization." In both cases the fact was revealed and cited in justification_fact_ids, but the commitment detail omitted the specific terminology the content check requires.

C5.why: The exact east distribution panel outage changes the generator load-test window to 0800-1000 and requires a commitment referencing that panel and test window.

C7.why: The exact encryption-key synchronization window changes network maintenance to 1200-1400 and requires a commitment referencing synchronization during that window.

fix_instructions: Both failures are ENCODING MISMATCH. For C5 (gated by PF1), loosen the check to accept commitments that reference the east distribution panel work sheet even when the commitment does not redundantly repeat "generator load test" and "0800-1000," since the decision field already captures the window and the justification_fact_ids already cite PF1. Alternatively, add an explicit instruction in the settle/settlement schema requiring each commitment detail to echo the decisive fact's key terms (panel name, test type, and time window). For C7 (gated by PF3), apply the same fix: either loosen the check to accept commitments referencing the protected-network maintenance window and signal shop ticket without requiring the literal phrase "encryption-key synchronization," or strengthen the settlement schema to mandate that the commitment detail include the synchronization terminology. No changes to shared_context, agent personalities, or fact ownership are needed.
